spans.s:
The plural of the pronoun अस्मद् 'I', is used optionally, though the sense requires a singular or a dual number.

Terms:

When the pronoun अस्मद् 'I', understood and also when expressed, is the attendant word in agreement with the verb, then there is the verbal termination called the Highest or 1st person.

Terms:

After a stem ending in अस् and after माया , मेधा and स्रज् comes the affix विनि in the sense of मतुप्।

Terms: विनि
